title: Dynamics 365 Sales: An agentic home for all sales AI
description:
When sellers open Dynamics 365 Sales, they can land in Sales agent: an agentic home for all sales AI instead of a traditional dashboard. Structured workflows in Sales agent bring agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together, giving sellers one place to understand what needs attention and what to do next without navigating separate agent experiences or working out the right prompt.

From this home, sellers can review prioritized recommendations and next steps from their agents, prepare for upcoming customer meetings, and review past meetings when the required meeting information is available. Sellers can understand the context behind their work and move from an insight to the next action in their selling workflow.
